pricing_scope: Standard API text-token list prices; no Batch/Flex discounts, Fast mode, regional premiums, tool fees, or subscription allowances.
notes: GPT-6 Luna rates below apply to prompts up to 272,000 input tokens. Longer prompts cost 2x input/cache rates and 1.5x output rates for the full request; the current flat-rate estimator does not apply these multipliers.

Cache-write cost is included only when cache-creation usage is reported. Codex turn summaries currently provide input, cached-input and output counts, so unreported cache writes are excluded from estimates.
Claude has no explicit configured model; no default model or Anthropic rate is assumed. CLI-reported USD remains available separately.
